brief:
Gaza garden designer Rashid Al-Masri is creating planted spaces across the territory to offer residents moments of joy and respite from the devastation of ongoing conflict, the Palestine News Network reported. Working amid widespread destruction that has upended daily life, Al-Masri has transformed vacant plots and damaged sites into gardens designed to provide psychological relief and aesthetic refuge.

The initiative reflects efforts by some Palestinians to reclaim normalcy and cultivate hope in their surroundings despite the toll of years of warfare. Al-Masri's work focuses on making beauty accessible to communities experiencing trauma and loss.
dek: GAZA CITY, Gaza Strip /PNN - Report by Rasha Ahmad - In Gaza, where years of conflict and destruction have disrupted nearly every aspect of daily life, a garden designer is turning his talent into an effort to create moments of beauty, joy and relief for…
title: Gaza garden designer builds beauty amid war's rubble
